main_body: Rounded leaf canopy made of several clumps (rows 0-55) on a brown trunk with a flared root base (rows 47-78)
top_band: Light-green clump highlights on the upper canopy (rows ~2-8, and again ~24-30), with the dark mid-green leaf mass below. The canopy has no flat slab top, but the lit top and shaded underside read as volume.
evidence: Each leaf clump has a lit upper cap and a darker lower belly. The deep shadow under the canopy sits directly above the trunk, so the crown reads as overhanging the trunk. The trunk shows a front face with a flared base. No receding side faces are drawn. For an organic tree this is an acceptable 3/4 read, matching the Beodeul trees.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 5 green steps (deep shadow, dark, mid, light, highlight) in clumps with per-leaf dithering. The trunk has 4 brown steps with vertical bark grain and a dark brown base. Outlines are dark green next to leaves and dark brown next to wood, not black. There are no large flat fills, and tile density is comparable to or richer than the references.
